headline: New King
caption:
Tye Ruotolo just choked out Christian Lee in Round 1 to take the ONE lightweight title.
Fluke or for real? 👇

The grappling prodigy is now 3-0 in MMA and the first two-sport world champion in ONE Championship history. Lee, fighting to avenge his brother Adrian, tapped at 2:08 at ONE The Inner Circle 37 in Bangkok.

🔥 Hot take: Tye Ruotolo is the scariest lightweight on the planet right now.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Fluke or for real?
hot_take: Tye Ruotolo is the *scariest* lightweight on the planet.
